title: File:In Lviv, Volodymyr Zelenskyy and Mette Frederiksen honored the memory of the fallen defenders of Ukraine. (53722946697).jpg
desc:
In Lviv, President of Ukraine Volodymyr Zelenskyy and Prime Minister of Denmark Mette Frederiksen, who is on a visit to our country, honored the memory of the defenders fallen during the Ukrainian-Russian war.
Volodymyr Zelenskyy and Mette Frederiksen laid flowers at the graves of Ukrainian warriors
